lines.text: Typing 'Buy milk' into the #item input and clicking the #add button creates a todo item with text 'Buy milk' in the #todo list (which goes from 0 to 1 items).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Typing 'Walk dog' into the #item input and pressing the Enter key creates a todo item with text 'Walk dog' in the #todo list.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Newly added items appear at the top of the #todo list: after adding 'Buy milk' then 'Walk dog', the list shows 'Walk dog' above 'Buy milk'.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Duplicate items are allowed: adding 'Buy milk' twice results in #todo containing 2 items both with text 'Buy milk'.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Submitting a whitespace-only value ('   ') via #add creates a todo item with no visible text (#todo has 1 item whose visible text is '').
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Clicking #add with an empty input creates no todo item (#todo and #completed both remain at 0 items).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: An empty task can be created (reported as a bug), showing an item with no text in the list.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Adding a very long single-word item ('Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-and-then-some-more-text') is accepted and displayed as one #todo item; long words are wrapped with word-break styling so they don't overflow.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Enter on the numeric keypad (Numpad-Enter) also submits a new todo item, not just the main Enter key.
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: Clicking the .complete control on an item in #todo moves it out of #todo (0 items) into #completed with the same text 'Buy milk'.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: With two items ('Buy milk' added first, 'Walk dog' on top), clicking .complete on the top item leaves #todo with 'Buy milk' and puts 'Walk dog' into #completed.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Clicking the .remove control on an item in #todo deletes it: after adding 'Buy milk' and 'Walk dog', removing one leaves #todo with 1 item 'Buy milk'.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: When two todo items have identical text (e.g. 'aa' added twice among 8 items), deleting one removes the first matching record in the data store (data.todo.splice(indexOf(value),1)), so after a page refresh the list order differs from what the DOM showed (bottom-to-top becomes bb, cc, dd, aa, bb, cc, dd instead of aa, bb, cc, dd, bb, cc, dd).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: The todo list data is stored locally (not on a server): items added on one device/browser do not appear when the app is opened on another device or browser — the list is empty there.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Clicking the .complete control on an item in #completed moves it back into #todo: after completing 'Buy milk' then clicking .complete on the completed item, #todo has 1 item 'Buy milk' and #completed has 0 items.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Clicking the .remove control on an item in #completed deletes it permanently: after completing 'Buy milk' then clicking .remove in #completed, both lists are empty (0 items each).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Completed items stack with the most recently completed on top: completing 'Buy milk' then 'Walk dog' results in #completed showing 'Walk dog' above 'Buy milk' (2 items).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: On the mobile version, after completing a task and un-completing it back into the list, the completed task marker (checkmark styling) incorrectly remains on the item.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Completing an item triggers a disappear animation on the item, and an item counter shows the number of tasks.
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: Tasks can be edited after creation (to correct e.g. grammatical errors), and the task buttons have tooltip tips explaining them.
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: Checking the items on a todo enables calorie tracking for that item.
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: Each task can have a time tracker showing elapsed time for the task.
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: The app starts with an empty state: both #todo and #completed contain 0 items with no visible text.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: The app is a single static HTML/CSS/JavaScript page; the todo list is not stored on a server, so the list state lives only in the browser.
lines.label: SEEN
